description: Blocks of type dynamic that a dynamic block generates aren't expanded
notes: The documentation of Expand says dynamic blocks can't themselves be generated except through nesting, but doesn't say what a dynamic block labeled dynamic does, and it only generates anything when the schema requests the block type dynamic, which the README doesn't provide for (see native/dynamic-blocks/requested-dynamic-type-still-expanded). hashicorp/hcl reads the dynamic block with its own header schema, which has one label, in place of the requested one without labels (expandBody.extendSchema in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go, and Body.PartialContent in hclsyntax/structure.go, which keeps the last header schema for a type). It generates ordinary blocks of type dynamic with the requested schema, and doesn't expand them, since it only expands the dynamic blocks it reads from the original body (expandBody.expandBlocks).
